summary: Receives OptiTrack/NatNet rigid-body tracking data over the network and outputs tracking channels.
key_concepts: OptiTrack In CHOP is a Windows-only receiver for OptiTrack/NatNet tracking data.
The docs state it currently receives Rigid Body data, so generated plans should not assume marker or skeleton streams.
Connection Type selects multicast or unicast, with Network Address still pointing at the OptiTrack server in multicast mode.
Local Address selects the local NIC on multi-adapter systems, while command and data ports must match NatNet/server settings.
This operator was previously called NatNet In CHOP, so old projects may use that legacy name.

key_params.name: netaddress
key_params.note: OptiTrack server computer name or IP address

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: Local NIC/IP wildcard or address to bind on multi-NIC systems

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
Only rigid-body data is currently received; do not plan for skeleton/marker streams unless verified elsewhere.
This operator was previously called NatNet In CHOP, so old projects/docs may use the legacy name.
In multicast mode, Network Address should still be the server address; the server negotiates multicast addressing.
Use Local Address when the machine has multiple network adapters and tracking should bind to a specific NIC.
Firewall and server NatNet settings must match connection type and ports before live data appears.
